result.instructions: Tools for ZapAssina, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the documents still waiting for signature in the Clientes/2026 folder."; "Create a service contract from our honorarios template for Maria da Silva."; "Move the signed document 3b7e to the Arquivo folder.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ZapAssina data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zapassina_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zapassina_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zapassina_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. zapassina_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zapassina_list_templates
tools.title: List document templates
tools.description: List the organization's document templates (Word models with {{fields}}). Returns the ZapAssina JSON. File links in the result expire after 60 minutes. ZapAssina API: GET /templates/.

tools.name: zapassina_get_template
tools.title: Get a document template
tools.description: Show one template: its fields (inputs), signers, public link and extra documents. Use the fields before creating a document from it. ZapAssina API: GET /templates/{token}/.

tools.name: zapassina_list_documents
tools.title: List and search documents
tools.description: List documents, newest first. Filters combine. Returns the ZapAssina JSON. File links in the result expire after 60 minutes. ZapAssina API: GET /docs/.

q.description: Search by name, verification code, signer, email or CPF.

date_field.description: Which date the period filters (default created).

created_by.description: Email of the user who sent the document.

template_id.description: Only documents made from this template token.

folder_path.description: Folder path such as /Clientes/2026, or / for no folder.

tools.name: zapassina_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Show one document: status, signers with their status and signing links, answers, and file links. Returns the ZapAssina JSON. File links in the result expire after 60 minutes. ZapAssina API: GET /docs/{token}/.

tools.name: zapassina_list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: List the document folders with their document counts. ZapAssina API: GET /folders/.

tools.name: zapassina_create_document_from_template
tools.title: Create a document from a template
tools.description: Create a signing document from a template. Fill the template fields with data (de = field name, para = value). Set send_automatic_email only when the user asked to send the invitation now. Plan quota applies. ZapAssina API: POST /models/create-doc/.

data.description: Field values: de = the field name such as {{CPF}}, para = the value. Unsent fields stay blank.

external_id.description: Your own id for this document.

date_limit_to_sign.description: Deadline to sign, yyyy-mm-dd. Max 365 days ahead. Omit for the organization default.

send_automatic_email.description: Send the invitation email now. Default false: the signing link is only returned. Use true only when the user asked to send it.

signer_has_incomplete_fields.description: True: the signer fills the blank fields at the signing link.

reminder_every_n_days.description: Reminder every N days; 0 turns it off.

observers.description: Emails that receive the final copy without signing.

annotations.title: Create a document from a template

tools.name: zapassina_create_document
tools.title: Create a document from a PDF
tools.description: Send a ready PDF for signature. Give exactly one of base64_pdf or url_pdf (PDF up to 25 MB). Set send_automatic_email only when the user asked to send the invitations now. Signature positions: anchors <<signer1>>, <<signer2>> and <<rubrica1>> in the PDF text. ZapAssina API: POST /docs/.

base64_pdf.description: PDF file as base64 (no data: prefix).

url_pdf.description: Public URL of the PDF. Redirects are not followed.

requirements.description: Auth points, for example DRAW_SIGNATURE and EMAIL_CODE.

qualification.description: Role shown on the document, for example Contratante or Testemunha.

date_limit_to_sign.description: Deadline to sign, yyyy-mm-dd. Max 365 days ahead. Omit for the organization default.

send_automatic_email.description: Send the invitation email now. Default false: the signing link is only returned. Use true only when the user asked to send it.

create_as_draft.description: True: keep as draft, no signing links yet.

annotations.title: Create a document from a PDF

tools.name: zapassina_cancel_document
tools.title: Cancel a document
tools.description: Cancel a document. Signing links stop working at once. This cannot be undone through the API. ZapAssina API: DELETE /docs/{token}/.

tools.name: zapassina_set_document_deadline
tools.title: Set or clear a document deadline
tools.description: Set a new deadline to sign, or clear it (clear_deadline true). A new deadline reopens an expired document. ZapAssina API: POST /docs/{token}/deadline/.

annotations.title: Set or clear a document deadline

tools.name: zapassina_move_document
tools.title: Move a document to a folder
tools.description: Move a document to a folder. Missing folders are created. Use / to remove it from all folders. ZapAssina API: POST /docs/{token}/folder/.

annotations.title: Move a document to a folder

tools.name: zapassina_resend_invitation
tools.title: Resend signing invitations
tools.description: Send the signing invitation again to pending signers who can sign now. Pass signer_token to send to one signer only. This sends a real message to the signer. ZapAssina API: POST /docs/{token}/resend/.

signer_token.description: Only this signer. Omit to send to all pending signers.

tools.name: zapassina_add_signer
tools.title: Add a signer to a document
tools.description: Add a signer to a document that is already sent. The signer joins at the end of the order and gets the invitation at once (or when their turn comes). This sends a real message. ZapAssina API: POST /docs/{token}/add-signer/.

requirements.description: Auth points, for example DRAW_SIGNATURE and EMAIL_CODE.

qualification.description: Role shown on the document, for example Contratante or Testemunha.

annotations.title: Add a signer to a document

tools.name: zapassina_update_signer
tools.title: Update a signer
tools.description: Correct a signer who has not signed yet. Omitted fields stay as they are. A new email or phone gives a new signing link. Set resend_invite only when the user asked to send the invitation again. ZapAssina API: POST /signers/{token}/.

signer_token.description: Signer token from the document's signers list.

resend_invite.description: True sends the invitation again. Default false.

tools.name: zapassina_remove_signer
tools.title: Remove a signer
tools.description: Remove a signer who has not signed yet. Their signing link stops working. If the others already signed, the document completes. ZapAssina API: DELETE /signers/{token}/.

tools.name: zapassina_create_folder
tools.title: Create a folder
tools.description: Create a document folder. Missing parent levels are created too (up to 5 levels). ZapAssina API: POST /folders/.

prompts.title: Get started with ZapAssina
prompts.description: What you can do with ZapAssina here, with example requests to try.
